SimpleSelect.description: Basic SELECT query: SELECT id, name FROM users
SimpleSelect.current_performance: ~318 ns/op on Apple M4 (median of 10 runs, re-measured 2026-10-13); ~467-918 ns/op typical on CI (GitHub ubuntu-latest Benchmark job, range over the last 9 Tests runs on main, 0715bb9..61ca6c8)
SimpleSelect.note: Measured with BenchmarkPerformanceBaseline (ParseFromModelTokens production path), -count=10 -benchmem, median. Baseline set at ~2.5x the M4 median: GitHub ubuntu-latest runners measure about 1.5-3.2x slower than M4 on these queries (up to ~3.2x), so a 1.5x baseline (limit ~2.4x M4 at this tolerance) would fail CI's slowest runs.
